name: Paymentus Holdings, Inc.
summary: Paymentus Holdings, Inc. provides cloud-based bill payment technology and solutions in the United States and internationally. The company offers electronic bill presentment and payment services, enterprise customer communication, and self-service revenue management to billers through a software-as-a-service, secure, and omni channel technology platform. Its platform's payment processing includes credit cards, debit cards, echecks, and digital wallets. The company serves utility, financial services, insurance, telecommunication, real estate management, education, consumer finance, healthcare, and business to business industries, as well as governments and small businesses.
